coverage_notes: All 50 files in alz2.txt were read in full (each header says only the first page of long threads was captured by the script, so later pages are not in the data). Empty comment bodies exist in 77401 (C11), 77402 (C7), 77436 (C4), 77448 (C6), 77454 (C8); 77429 post body is a site rendering error so only the comment is usable. 77405 (memory care checklist) and 77446 (student promoting a smart dispenser) read as promotional posts, not caregiver voices; 77433 (Bible verse), 77431/77452 (forum navigation), 77472 (daily chit-chat thread) have little caregiving-problem content. Several threads are in the 'Caring for a Spouse or Partner' board so spouse caregivers dominate. Gap lists: all six have at least one entry. Nothing was found about group texts, shared spreadsheets, or shared calendars between siblings; family information sharing evidence is mostly about its absence or about paper/phone tools. T14 is used heavily for hospice/end-of-life, personal-care/incontinence, and forum-navigation threads.

caveats: ALZConnected is a self-selected online support community; spouse caregivers (often older, with dementia of a husband or wife) are over-represented relative to adult children, and members are already seeking help, which skews toward people in distress. Only the first page of each long thread was captured. A few posts are promotional (77405, 77446) or social (77433, 77472) and should not be counted as caregiver problem evidence. Cared_for is coded from stated text only; 'unclear' where not stated. Primary-theme counts: T9 appears most often as primary (12), then T14 (9, mostly hospice/end-of-life, personal care and forum-navigation), then T2 (7). No evidence was found of siblings using group texts, spreadsheets or shared apps; the absence in this small sample should not be read as proof they do not exist.
